title: What makes a good metric? Evaluating automatic metrics for text-to-image consistency

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of LM-generated yes/no questions for VQA models to calculate the percentage where the ground-truth correct answer is 'yes' (revealing a ~99% affirmative skew).
Analyzing the distribution of LM-generated multiple-choice questions for VQA models to calculate the percentage where the correct ground-truth answer is simply the first provided choice.
